category.leaf: 大容量扩容分区收纳拉杆箱

description: 扩展隐藏层大容量、分区收纳、六色可选的商务旅行拉杆箱套图模版

styleLock.backgroundSystem: geometric color-block walls in sage green tones with a polished light marble floor; white rounded-corner info cards floating over flat color fields, with soft light-grey #F2F1EF panels reserved for detail montages
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft directional key light from front-left at 5200K, gentle fill, soft contact shadow under the product; clean commercial studio mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte painted wall panels plus polished light-grey marble floor #E8E6E1
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short bold headlines only, dark charcoal #2D2D2D on light cards and #FFFFFF on deep green fields
styleLock.iconSystem: flat rounded-square line icons in sage green #A9C39B with thin strokes, one concept per icon, generous padding
styleLock.presentationRules: stable 3/4 hero angle for full-product shots; consistent product scale; product always grounded with a contact shadow; info cards keep fixed corner radius and tab placement
noDrift: no extra decorative leaves beyond the opening hero
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh minimalist travel-luggage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty sage green #A9C39B, clean white #FFFFFF, deep forest green #3D5A47 and warm copper accent #C88F52, with soft light-grey #F2F1EF kept for detail montage panels and info card fills; neutral-warm studio lighting with a soft directional key from front-left at 5200K and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines only; consistent white rounded-corner info cards with a small sage-green square corner tab; consistent flat rounded-square line icons in sage green #A9C39B; clean product photography staged against geometric color-block walls with a polished light marble floor #E8E6E1; stable product scale and placement with natural breathing room around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

Soft directional key light from front-left at 5200K, gentle fill, soft contact shadow grounding the case on the polished marble floor. provenance.notes: 12 张 800x1200 详情页切片提炼。已剥离：源品牌拉链字样、会员招募二维码与店铺促销贴纸、英文装饰占位词与全部源文案（转为 callout/selling_point 占位符，各镜在 1-9 区间内独立复用）。源图多处细节图为灰色空占位（面板2/3/11）及产品缺图的尺寸标注（面板12），已按版式结构推断重建。源色卡中黄色格的英文标注与中文名不一致，模版以取色 hex 为准。品类判定：L1=箱包、L2=旅行，与源文件夹层级一致；实际内容为硬壳拉杆箱，定位以「扩展隐藏层大容量+分区收纳」与库内既有 4 款拉杆箱模版（基础款/铝镁合金硬壳/磨砂PC/复古铝框竖条纹）区分。
